proposals.evidence: Turner explicitly gives Gujarati/Marathi rĩgṇī eggplant (Solanum jacquinii), Gujarati rĩgṇũ fruit and Marathi rĩgṇẽ under riṅgaṇī. These Bhili/Nimadi survey r(i)ŋ(g)aṇ- forms fit that western plant-name family, including weakened or unrecorded g; the generic survey eggplant sense does not identify the exact botanical species or prove Turner’s tentative deeper connection with riṅg creep.
